title: Capturing Nuanced Preferences: Preference-Aligned Distillation for Small Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's preference for longer responses using the 'Prob. prefer longer' metric on the Alpaca-eval Evaluator test set, and reporting length-controlled (LC) win rates to account for and mitigate verbosity bias.
Mitigating the mismatch between training and inference phases by sampling and training the student model on its own self-generated responses rather than relying solely on ground truth contexts.
